date_trunc('month', a.att03_work_date) LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr ON apr.apr01_appr_id = a.att03_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN att13_overtime_req_hist a13 ON a13.att13_overtime_req_id = a.att03_overtime_req_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.att03_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(apr.apr01_status_cd, '99') = '30' ORDER BY a.att03_work_date , CASE a.att03_work_type_cd WHEN '30' THEN 1 WHEN '10'
